This is a lesson on one drum groove the [Backing Track](../../tools/backing-track.qmd) band plays: **Quarter notes (learning swing, 1)**. It is one of the first patterns to learn, so this page starts from it and takes it into the band. How the examples work: press ▶ Play, switch players in and out with the buttons beside it, and read the band's last four bars on the staff underneath. The tempo slider at the bottom of the page slows everything down.

[All the accompaniment patterns](index.qmd) · [Drum grooves](index.qmd#drums)

## The pattern

Only the beat: the cymbal on 1, 2, 3 and 4 and the hi-hat foot on 2 and 4. No kick, no snare, no fills. The first thing to play on a blues.

It belongs in *Swing*, *Jazz ballad*, *Stride piano* and *Boogie-woogie*. Here it is in the swing style with the whole band. Switch the other players off to hear it alone.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="swing" data-chart="Dm7|G7|Cmaj7|A7|Dm7|G7|Cmaj7|Cmaj7" data-tempo="120" data-on="bass comp drums congas" data-staves="drums" data-choice-label="Drum groove:" data-choices='[{"label":"Quarter notes (learning swing, 1)","opts":{"groove":"quarters"}}]'></div>

## Step 1: Quarter notes (learning swing, 1), slowly

**How to play it.** Right hand on the ride cymbal on every beat; left foot closes the hi-hat on 2 and 4. Nothing else. This is the pulse every jazz drummer plays on top of.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="swing" data-chart="Dm7|G7|Cmaj7|A7|Dm7|G7|Cmaj7|Cmaj7" data-tempo="84" data-on="drums" data-staves="drums" data-choice-label="Compare:" data-choices='[{"label":"Quarter notes (learning swing, 1)","opts":{"groove":"quarters"}}]'></div>

## Step 2: Up to tempo, with the band

The whole band, at 120 beats a minute. Play along, then switch the band's drum kit off and take the part yourself.

## In other styles
